fields.description: Issue includes an editorial and reporting on an alleged Miami Beach gambling “syndicate” and its influence over local enforcement and politics, including references to the city manager and sheriff. It continues coverage of the “Torture Doctor” (Dr. T. E. Moore), including correspondence involving the American Psychoanalytic Association and discussion of multiple divorce filings and allegations of cruelty. Additional content includes letters and Q&A regarding Salvation Army fundraising and services, a medical commentary on costs of pneumonia treatment and health economics, local music and cultural listings, and nightlife/entertainment columns and advertisements.
